standard-dialogue-before-building-the-fi.npc: Build us a stove mate, I'm absolutely starvin!

standard-dialogue-before-building-the-fi.player: You must be really tired from the journey, you did so much.

standard-dialogue-before-building-the-fi.npc: ...So my expertise were not required this time, a man's still gotta eat.

standard-dialogue-before-building-the-fi.player: I guess I'll get building then...

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.npc: About these eggs... Odd colour, don't cha think?

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.player: The birds here are a little exotic, apparently.

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.npc: Hmm, well, good effort, but I'll pass on the grub this time.

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.player: What if I gave you a box?

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.npc: I'm not sure that'll change my mind.

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.player: If not a box, then what about a fox?
A mouse, a house? Would these change your mind?

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.npc: For the love of Saradomin, please leave me be

standard-dialogue-after-building-the-fir.player: I will! I promise! Just try them and you'll see.
